name: Tsuboi Akie
source:
Eiji's older sister. Immediately after she gave birth, her husband went on a long business trip and she returned to her family home.
She is an open-minded person but tends to ignore her brother's human rights.
She sometimes comes to check on him at the wrong time.

[Translated from ErogameScape]
